title: Discovery and pilot definition
acceptance_criteria: Conduct 3 buyer and 7 employee interviews; map five roles; record two partner decisions, rubric and pilot constraints.
status: Awaiting buyer interviews and two design partners

title: Identity tenancy and authorisation foundation
acceptance_criteria: OIDC login; role/resource authorisation; transaction-scoped forced RLS; cross-tenant denial tests pass.

title: Domain schema and versioning
acceptance_criteria: Migrations create same-tenant FKs, immutable revisions, audit/outbox tables and seed taxonomy; rollback procedure reviewed.

title: CSV inventory import
acceptance_criteria: Preview reports row errors; limits enforced; confirm atomic; duplicate digest/external IDs do not duplicate records; exports formula-safe.

title: Employee review and corrections
acceptance_criteria: Employees review own tasks; authorised corrections create versions; stale writes rejected and dependent results flagged.

title: Queue worker and AI adapter
acceptance_criteria: Outbox recovers publish failure; duplicate jobs safe; bounded retries/dead letters; validated de-identified output; token quota and outage fallback exercised.

title: Assessment review and benchmark
acceptance_criteria: Five-role labelled benchmark meets agreed thresholds; explanations/provenance displayed; uncertainty routed to review; overrides audited.
status: Implemented; expert labels and quality sign-off pending

title: Skills taxonomy and gap engine
acceptance_criteria: Versioned role targets and self-reported/verified proficiency produce reproducible gaps; unknown stays distinct; no employee score.

title: 30-day plans and manager approval
acceptance_criteria: Curated resources and time budget generate 30-day draft; exact revision approval required; edits invalidate approval; active plan dates deterministic.

title: Evidence and skill verification
acceptance_criteria: Private uploads quarantined/scanned; employee cannot self-verify; reviewer records rubric decision; completion differs from verification.
status: Implemented; live S3 and ClamAV deployment validation pending

title: Manager dashboard and pilot metrics
acceptance_criteria: Assigned-team scope enforced; completion/verification distinct; acceptance and cohort completion denominators documented and tested.

title: Privacy retention and deletion
acceptance_criteria: Approved retention configured; export/deletion traverses derived records and objects; backup restoration reapplies deletion; audit policy documented.

title: Security and AI abuse testing
acceptance_criteria: Cross-tenant IDs, URLs, exports, malicious CSV/uploads and prompt injection covered; no unresolved high/critical findings.

title: End-to-end accessibility and load checks
acceptance_criteria: Employee-to-manager-to-evidence journey passes; WCAG 2.2 AA checks and assumed load/SLO measurements recorded; gaps resolved.
status: Partially validated; browser review and load SLO remain open

title: CI infrastructure and operations
acceptance_criteria: IaC and environments configured; CI checks/builds pass; secrets external; restore, rollback, queue/provider outage drills meet accepted targets.
status: Implemented; container CI in progress and production rehearsal pending

title: Pilot onboarding and release readiness
acceptance_criteria: All release gates signed off; two partner tenants onboarded; five-role dry run and reviewer training complete.
status: Awaiting release gates and two real partner onboardings

title: Pilot outcome evaluation
acceptance_criteria: After 30-day observation, publish acceptance/completion/verification, cohort exclusions, model errors, cost/task and buyer payment decision.
